pets.title: A prescribed project he is afraid to fail, in front of everyone

pets.title: Afraid it will prove him someone who breaks
pets.description: Signed off last autumn, sceptical and hard to own it, and mistakes on show for anyone to see

pets.title: Books, a spreadsheet and one target, against the clay
pets.description: Preparing by reading, the not-work made a project, and still going in October

pets.title: Hiding from the people at the plot, every look a verdict
pets.description: An old man's remark heard as a verdict, no mute in person, new gloves watched, and twenty minutes in the car

T1:3:0.text: Sceptical but unable to say no
quotes: "Honestly? Sceptical. Quite sceptical. My therapist suggested it … And I didn't feel I could turn down three years of waiting just because I was sceptical."
notes: 'Which I'm aware is a sentence.' Laughed at the therapist, felt bad. The universe 'a bit pointed'.

T1:5:0.text: Hard to own being someone told to try gardening
quotes: "Like I'd become the sort of person who gets told to try gardening. I was signed off work for six weeks last autumn, so I suppose I am that sort of person now. That's quite hard to say out loud, actually."
notes: The leaflet: have you tried gardening? Being that sort of person 'hard to say out loud'.

T1:7:0.text: Undone by work he is good at
quotes: "And I'm good at it, I'm actually very good at it, that's sort of the problem. … And one Tuesday in October I just couldn't open the laptop."
notes: Other people's problems in a queue. Good at it, 'that's sort of the problem'. A hand on the lid for an hour.

T1:11:0.text: Glad of the first place in two years without the laptop
quotes: "I can see the laptop from the sofa, and from the bed if the door's open. … The plot's the first place in two years that doesn't have the laptop in it somewhere."
notes: Smells of other people's shirts. The bedroom door shut on the laptop. The plot free of it.

T1:13:0.text: Hoping for a problem with no one attached
quotes: "Quiet my head, I suppose. … So I want one problem that's just soil and weather. That nobody can email me about. … A problem with no one attached to it."
notes: Forty tabs and one playing music. Soil and weather, no ticket, no appraisal: a problem with no one in it.

T1:15:0.text: Four books no use against the clay
quotes: "I read four books first, which is very me. … And then I got there, and the books were no use at all. … It stuck to the fork like it had opinions."
notes: 'Which is very me.' Nine hours of videos. Clay with opinions.

T1:17:0.text: A fraud in new gloves, watched by an old man
quotes: "I stood there in brand new gloves, still with the label on … and I felt like a complete fraud. … And there's an old man on the next plot, Des … and he'd been watching me."
notes: The cardboard tag still on the gloves. Cosplaying a gardener.

T1:19:0.text: Unable to tell kindness from threat in an old man's words
quotes: "Which was either kind or a threat, I genuinely couldn't tell. … I read everything as an evaluation. Everyone's a performance review."
notes: Four hours on one sentence of Des's. Kind or a threat?

T1:21:0.text: Lost for what to do with his face among people
quotes: "But in person I don't really know where to put myself any more. … I don't know what to do with my face. … In real life there's no mute."
notes: No mute in real life. Head down, hoping nobody comes over: the opposite of the prescription.

T1:23:0.text: Digging terrible and amazing, after years lived from the neck up
quotes: "Oh, terrible. And kind of amazing. I've been living from the neck up for about ten years, I think. … it was the first time in months I knew where my hands were."
notes: Terrible and amazing. Nine hours' sleep, the first since university.

T1:25:0.text: Hands his own again, as if back from away
quotes: "At the plot they were cold and they were sore and there was clay under the nails that wouldn't come out, and they were mine. … Like they'd been away somewhere and come back."
notes: Hands as input devices at work. Turning them over on the bus. 'Slightly embarrassing to say to someone with a recorder.'

T1:29:0.text: Watching himself make a project of it
quotes: "so you've turned the thing that was meant to be not work into a project with a timeline. … I can watch myself doing it from about three feet away, and I still do it. Knowing doesn't stop it."
notes: Watches himself from three feet away. Knowing does not stop it.

T1:33:0.text: Mistakes on show for anyone passing
quotes: "At work you can hide a mistake in a log file, nobody reads the logs. Here your mistakes are just out there, in rows, for anyone who walks past. … It's a very public way to be bad at something."
notes: Logs nobody reads against rows anyone can see.

T1:35:0.text: Afraid the plot will prove him someone who breaks
quotes: "But if I can't even do this … then maybe it wasn't a blip. Maybe that's just what I'm like now. Maybe I'm someone who breaks."
notes: A blip or what he is now? 'Someone who breaks.' Rather not find out in front of Des.

T1:37:0.text: One target despite himself: still going in October
quotes: "So I haven't set targets. Except I have, obviously. … Still turning up in October. That's the key performance indicator. I'm aware that's a joke and not a joke."
notes: The one target, a KPI. 'A joke and not a joke.'

T1:39:0.text: Picturing a rest without guilt he cannot reach
quotes: "Me, on a fold-up chair, at the end of a row of something green, not doing anything, not thinking about anything, and not feeling guilty … I just don't know how you get from the spreadsheet to the chair."
notes: The chair, not the spreadsheet. 'Maybe that's what the year is for.'

T1:41:0.text: Hiding in the car from the gate, a low moment
quotes: "I sat in the car in the car park for twenty minutes before I got out. … There were two people at the gate talking, and I waited until they'd gone. … It was a bit of a low moment, if I'm honest."
notes: Twenty minutes in the car, engine off, phone as cover.

pets.title: “All my tabs” closed for an hour: a quiet he cannot schedule
pets.description: An hour tying tomatoes without a thought, held very still, not to be made to happen, and a head not broken after all

pets.title: An hour of quiet he was afraid to move in
pets.description: Tying tomatoes in the mist, the quiet gone at a glance at the phone, and a tiredness that lets him sleep

pets.title: Not to be scheduled, and a head not broken
pets.description: Possible but not to order, a different problem, and calm some days, the worry moved on others

pets.title: Keeping people off with headphones, and reached anyway
pets.description: The window chosen over the party, nobody in particular, asking nothing, and reached by hazel poles and a bag of tomatoes

pets.title: At the window, nobody in particular
pets.description: Headphones playing nothing, nearly envious of the regulars, restful to be unmissed, and asking Des nothing

pets.title: Reached by hazel poles and a bag of tomatoes
pets.description: Des's poles after a remark heard as contempt, and good news to say at work

pets.title: On call and marked, even at the plot
pets.description: Slugs hunted at night like a broken system, comforted by everyone's failure, and the plot reported to his therapist like homework

pets.title: On call for the slugs, and laughing at himself
pets.description: Lettuces lost as a personal attack, a night shift in a field, and not uniquely bad

pets.title: Going for his therapist, the plot a report to hand in
pets.description: Some weeks for her, the good days the ones he forgets to tell, and on track against a target

T2:3:0.text: Calm some days, the worry moved outdoors on others
quotes: "Some days I come back calm. Properly calm, like something's been taken out of my head and put down somewhere. … So I haven't stopped worrying. I've just moved the worry."
notes: 'The most honest sentence I've said all year.' The worry relocated, outdoors, about lettuces.

T2:5:0.text: Lost lettuces taken personally, slugs hunted at night
quotes: "And I took it personally. I really did. I took it as a personal attack. That night I went back at eleven o'clock with a head torch and a bucket … Which is not, I'm aware, the behaviour of a calm person."
notes: Twenty-four lettuces, done 'literally by the book'. A personal attack.

T2:7:0.text: Despairing and laughing on call in a field
quotes: "I thought, this is my job. This is literally my job. Something's broken, it's urgent, and I'm on call. … And I laughed. … Despairing and funny at the same time."
notes: A night shift built for himself in a field. Laughs out loud, alone. Sleeps after, as he never does after work.

T2:11:0.text: An hour tying tomatoes in the mist without a single thought
quotes: "And I tied in the tomatoes. Just that. … And I didn't think about anything at all, for an hour. Nothing. I couldn't tell you the last time that happened."
notes: Mist, bean poles, nobody about, not even Des. String, tomato leaves. 'That's all there was.'

T2:13:0.text: The quiet gone at a glance at the phone
quotes: "It was like somebody had closed all my tabs. All forty. … I was a bit scared to move. In case they all came back. … And then I looked at my phone to check the time and they all came back."
notes: All forty tabs closed. Holding the string still 'like you would with a bird'. The phone brings them back.

T2:15:0.text: Quiet possible but not to order
quotes: "You can't schedule it. Which is very annoying for someone like me … But it happened, once, so I know it's possible. That's new."
notes: Scheduling is 'basically my whole personality'. It cannot be scheduled, and it happened.

T2:17:0.text: Relieved to find his head not broken
quotes: "So it can stop. It's not broken, it's just never been turned off. That's a different problem. … But it's a different problem, and I quite like having a different problem."
notes: A server room never turned off. Not broken. Likes having a different problem.

T2:19:0.text: Silent headphones to keep people off
quotes: "I'll be honest, half the time there's nothing playing. They're just in. They're a sign. Do not disturb. … But I'm not there for people."
notes: Headphones with nothing playing. 'There to not be there for people.'

T2:21:0.text: Nearly envious of the regulars, from a window he chose
quotes: "Envious isn't quite it. It's like watching a party through a window. And I've chosen the window. … But I've chosen the window, and I keep choosing it."
notes: A party through a window, the window chosen, and chosen again.

T2:23:0.text: Restful to be nobody in particular
quotes: "And then they'd know me, and then they'd notice when I'm not there, and then I'd have to explain. … That's quite restful, actually. Being nobody in particular."
notes: Being somebody on calls all day. Unmissed is restful. Noticed means explaining.

T2:25:0.text: Asking nothing so as to be asked nothing
quotes: "I haven't asked. I don't ask people things, at the moment. If you ask people things they ask you things back."
notes: Assumes Des is just an old man who likes his allotment. Asks nothing, to be asked nothing.

T2:27:0.text: Tomatoes to give away, and a talk at work not about a ticket
quotes: "And we talked for twenty minutes. About tomatoes. About her dad's greenhouse. Twenty minutes. That's the longest conversation I've had at work in a year that wasn't about a ticket."
notes: A second head 'in a nice way, mostly'. Twenty minutes not about a ticket.

T2:31:0.text: Something good to say at last
quotes: "I think the plot's the first thing in years that I've got something to say about that isn't a complaint. … It's good news. I didn't have any good news. Now I've got tomatoes."
notes: Every topic a complaint, the plot the exception.

T2:33:0.text: Hazel poles after a remark heard as contempt
quotes: "and I went straight to, he thinks I'm useless … And then the next day there were six hazel poles leaning on my shed. From him. No note. Just poles. So I've decided Des is not a performance review."
"Because everyone had slugs. Everyone lost their lettuces. It wasn't me being uniquely bad, it was just May. Which is a strange thing to be comforted by. Collective slug failure."
notes: Hazel poles, no note. Des 'not a performance review': a decision, still being worked on.

T2:33:1.text: Comforted that everyone lost lettuces: not uniquely bad
quotes: "and I went straight to, he thinks I'm useless … And then the next day there were six hazel poles leaning on my shed. From him. No note. Just poles. So I've decided Des is not a performance review."
"Because everyone had slugs. Everyone lost their lettuces. It wasn't me being uniquely bad, it was just May. Which is a strange thing to be comforted by. Collective slug failure."
notes: Hazel poles, no note. Des 'not a performance review': a decision, still being worked on.

T2:35:0.text: Some weeks going for his therapist, not for himself
quotes: "Because it makes it feel like homework again. Like I'm handing in my plot to be marked. … Some weeks I'm going for her, not for me."
notes: Handing in the plot to be marked. Her pleasure makes it homework.

T2:37:0.text: Good days the ones he forgets to report on
quotes: "So then I'm doing the plot and the report about the plot at the same time, and that's two jobs. The good days are the ones where I forget to tell her."
notes: Narrating to her in his head: the plot and the report on it, two jobs.

T2:39:0.text: A welcome tiredness that lets him sleep
quotes: "My hands are completely different. Calluses … I look like two different people stitched together. … The screen tired is sort of buzzy. The plot tired is heavy and it lets you go."
notes: Two people stitched together, the tanned arm and the office arm.

T2:41:0.text: Hearing himself say he is on track
quotes: "Only that I'm still going. … So I'm on track. I'm aware I've just described my own life as being on track against a target. I can hear it."
notes: On track against a target. 'I can hear it.'

pets.title: Fetched back by a note on the shed, to Des at last
pets.description: Noticed missing and given a job instead of a feeling, then headphones out and an old man's grief, and onions that bore him

pets.title: A note on the shed: noticed missing, given a job
pets.description: The first note in years not about work, no explaining asked, and a ticket that was the best thing all year

pets.title: Headphones out, and Des known at last
pets.description: An hour with Des, ashamed of clicking him away, easy beside him now, and bored by onions

pets.title: Last autumn back at the black beans: another thing stopped
pets.description: Letting the plot go over, the old panic and the calm called fake, stopping quietly as before, and a body that knew first

pets.title: No cure, but he knows “which room it lives in”
pets.description: Not to be switched on, but a room it lives in, string in hand, and the plot somewhere to be

pets.title: “I need it, which is different”: a plot that does not care
pets.description: Frightened to need anything, relieved by the one thing not judging him, and the plot his own, not homework

T3:3:0.text: Feeling he had let a plot down
quotes: "I didn't decide to stop. I just didn't go … And I stood there and I felt I'd let it down. Which is ridiculous. It's a plot."
notes: Did not decide to stop, just did not go. 'You can't let a rectangle down', and he felt he had.

T3:5:0.text: Last autumn back at the black beans, the calm called fake
quotes: "It was the exact feeling from last autumn. … I had the whole thing come back, the chest, the hands going. … The calm was fake. … You can't even keep a vegetable patch alive."
notes: The chest, the hands, by Des's shed. 'See.' The summer called a holiday.

T3:9:0.text: Another thing quietly stopped, as before, with nobody chasing
quotes: "I'm good at starting things. … And then something gets hard and I just quietly stop, and I don't tell anyone … If you stop quietly enough, nobody chases you."
notes: The climbing wall, the friends, the group chat: stopping quietly. Nobody chases.

T3:11:0.text: Moved by a handwritten note not about work
quotes: "And I stood there and read it about five times. And I realised it was the first note anyone had left me in years that wasn't about work. … Somebody had written something down for me, by hand, about my leeks."
notes: On the back of a seed packet, a drawing pin, a D. Read five times.

T3:13:0.text: Noticed missing and not made to explain
quotes: "But he'd noticed I wasn't there. That's what got me. Somebody noticed I wasn't there and didn't make it a thing. Didn't ask why. Didn't make me explain."
notes: Not 'are you all right'. Noticed, and not made to explain. 'As if I was coming back.'

T3:15:0.text: Given a job instead of a feeling
quotes: "But leeks want lifting. That I could do. That was a job. He gave me a job instead of a feeling. I think he knew. I think he's been around a lot of people who stop."
notes: A job instead of a feeling. Des 'has been around a lot of people who stop'.

T3:17:0.text: Learning only now what Des carries, after months of waving
quotes: "And I took my headphones out, both of them, and we talked. For about an hour. … And it turns out his wife died two years ago. … I'd been waving at him for eight months and I had no idea."
notes: Both headphones out. Eight months of waving and no idea.

T3:19:0.text: Finding in the plot what the flat is not: somewhere to be
quotes: "The flat is somewhere I am. It's not somewhere I'm at. … The plot's the only place I go to be at."
notes: Somewhere I am against somewhere I'm at. Des worked it out for him.

quotes: "I'd been treating him like a pop-up. … And I'd been performing not needing anyone. Very hard. With headphones. I felt quite ashamed of that, actually"
notes: A pop-up clicked away unread. Ashamed, 'standing there with my leeks'.

T3:23:0.text: At ease beside Des now, hardly listening
quotes: "But sometimes I walk over to his shed and stand there while he does something, and he tells me what he's doing, and I don't really listen, and it's fine."
notes: A gooseberry he does not know what to do with.

T3:25:0.text: Contacted after all, and glad: a ticket from Des
quotes: "Because Des basically emailed me. On paper. … It was literally a ticket. And it was the best thing that happened to me all year. … I wanted nobody to contact me about things that aren't real."
notes: The ticket he fled turns up on paper, and is the best thing all year. Real against not real.

T3:27:0.text: The quiet no cure but findable
quotes: "It comes and goes. It's not a cure. … But I know where to find it now. That's what's different."
notes: Not a cure: his therapist would like it in a report.

T3:29:0.text: Putting himself in the way of quiet, string in hand, never in the chair
quotes: "I can't make it happen. But I can go where it happens. … I can't switch it on, but I know which room it lives in. … The quiet never came in the chair. It came with string in my hands."
notes: Which room it lives in. The chair in the shed with the spider, never sat in.

T3:31:0.text: The plot kept from his therapist as his own
quotes: "I stopped telling her about it in September … It started to feel like mine. Not homework. I didn't want to hand it in any more."
notes: Stopped telling her before he stopped going. 'Maybe I learned it from him.'

T3:33:0.text: Needing the plot without loving it
quotes: "I think I need it, which is different. … I don't love it. Some days I really don't like it at all. But I need it. When I didn't go for three weeks, something went wrong in me."
notes: Not like people in magazines. Need is not love.

T3:35:0.text: Frightened to need even a rectangle of clay
quotes: "Wanting is nice. Needing is a bit frightening. … I don't like needing things. … And now I need a rectangle of clay."
"I think what I needed most this year was something that doesn't care about me at all. The plot doesn't care. … It's the one thing in my life that isn't evaluating me."
notes: Does his own tech support. Needs a rectangle of clay that does not care.

T3:35:1.text: Relief in a plot that does not care about him
quotes: "Wanting is nice. Needing is a bit frightening. … I don't like needing things. … And now I need a rectangle of clay."
"I think what I needed most this year was something that doesn't care about me at all. The plot doesn't care. … It's the one thing in my life that isn't evaluating me."
notes: Does his own tech support. Needs a rectangle of clay that does not care.

T3:37:0.text: A body that knew before he did that he had stopped
quotes: "When I stopped going in September, the sleep went first. Before I'd even noticed I'd stopped going, I was lying awake again at three. My body knew before I did."
notes: The body keeping a better record than him. 'Less grey', taken as a compliment.

T3:39:0.text: Glad to be bored by onions with Des
quotes: "But actually, I took them out last week. Without planning it. … It was quite boring, honestly. Onions are quite boring. But it was fine. … And it was one of the better ten minutes of my year."
notes: Planned for spring, done last week. Bored by onions, no mute needed.
